description.en: The application ID. You can create and query the application ID in the console. Only a single ID can be passed.

```
TemplateIds.1=****
TemplateIds.2=****
......
```

To obtain a template ID, see [AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~).

title.zh: 查询录制模板配置列表
title.en: Queries a list of recording template configurations

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~)添加录制配置模板。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes
Before you call this operation, you must call the [AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~) operation to add a recording template.
# QPS limits
The per-user QPS limit of this operation is 100 calls per second. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~341645~~).
